A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a new approach to quantum field theory which is based on the concept of charge class.
the charge structure of a local quantum field theory is a rich source of information on the structure of its physical state space.
the physical state space can be described in terms of the charge classes, and that these can be characterized in terms of the spectrum.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the charge structure of a physical system is a fundamental property, which is not affected by infrared problems.
the charge structure of any local quantum field theory can be systematically investigated and that it is intimately connected with the particle structure.
there is a well defined notion of statistics for any simple charge class and that the particle aspects of a theory are fully encoded in the charge classes of its observables.
